title: Gel na bayan gida, gilashin fesa da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta: haɗari uku ana sarrafa
course_title: Samfuran Kayan Wuta & Tsabtace Kayayyakin: Taron Bitar Samfura Shida

say: Gel na bayan gida, gilashin fesa da maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta: haɗari uku ana sarrafa.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don tsari na 3: Kayayyakin Kwararru.
Waɗannan samfuran guda uku kowanne yana ɗauke da takamaiman haɗari. Gel ɗin bayan gida acid ne.

say: Zoben da ke cikin bayan gida yawanci ma'aunin ma'adinai ne daga ruwa mai wuya da fitsari.
Yana buƙatar acid da lokaci.
Yawancin masu tsabtace kantuna suna amfani da acid hydrochloric, ruhun gishiri.
Yana da sauri, amma yana ba da hayaki mai lalacewa, yana ƙone fata da kyau kuma yana cin kayan ƙarfe.

panel.heading: Me yasa citric acid, ba hydrochloric ba
left: Kone mai tsanani, yana lalata kayan aiki
right: A hankali, yana buƙatar lokacin hulɗa
Mafi sauƙin ɗauka a cikin taron bita

say: Wannan hanya tana amfani da citric acid.
Yana aiki da sannu a hankali, don haka gel mai kauri yana manne a cikin kwano, kuma kwatancenku suna ba shi lokaci: bar akalla minti 10, ko na dare don ma'auni mai nauyi, sannan gogewa da gogewa.

say: Gilashin tabarau da safar hannu a kunne, saboda ƙurar citric acid na harbi idanu.

panel.rule: Yi amfani da matakin da lokacin tuntuɓar tuntuɓar ku daga takardar mai kawo kaya.

say: Datti yana garkuwa da ƙwayoyin cuta, don haka kwatance suna farawa da: tsabta da farko. Dole ne saman ya kasance jika don cikakken lokacin hulɗa. Yin fesa da bushewa a lokaci guda baya aiki.
Kuma kiyaye BKC daga ruwan tasa. A cikin gwajin kwalba, haɗin ya zama gajimare, kuma BKC ba zai iya kashe ƙwayoyin cuta ba.

say: Kada a taɓa buga adadin kashe ƙwayoyin cuta sai dai idan an gwada samfurin ku.
Kar a taba ba da shawarar cewa yana kare mutane daga cututtuka.
Kuma ku yi magana da ofishin ku na NAFDAC na jiha kafin ku sayar da wani abu mai suna maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta.

say: Don tunawa.
Acid da lokaci yana cire ma'auni.
Citric acid ya fi aminci.
Mai tsabtace gilashi yana buƙatar ɗan ƙaramin ruwa mai laushi da ruwa mai laushi.
Ka kiyaye barasa daga wuta.
Kuma don maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta, bi takardar mai siyarwar ku, haɗa BKC kawai tare da marasa lafiya, kuma kuyi da'awar gaskiya kawai.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Ma'aunin bayan gida yana buƙatar acid da lokacin hulɗa
Citric acid yana da aminci fiye da hydrochloric
Gilashin: ƙaramin surfactant, ruwa mai laushi, babu ammonia
IPA tana da ƙonewa sosai: babu wuta
BKC: Matsayin mai kaya, nonionics kawai, babu hayaniya

say: Yanzu yi gel bayan gida mai nauyin kilogiram 1 kuma gwada shi sau biyu na tuntuɓar juna, gudanar da gwajin rabin madubi, sa'annan ku yi gwajin batch ɗinka na maganin kashe kwayoyin cuta da gwajin kwalba. Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
